jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**The Role**

Having built strong foundations in India, we now operate across multiple international markets and are expanding into new ones. International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay’s products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work — on top of a platform and systems layer that has to be rebuilt for each market’s rails, currency, regulation and settlement cycle. Much of this is 0 to 1 work. You will be deciding what to build, building it with engineering, taking it to merchants, and growing it. There is no running playbook to inherit. You will write it.

This is a builder role as much as a product role. In a new market, Razorpay has no brand recall and few relationships, so you will open doors yourself and because a new market means new rails, you will also own the systems underneath — machinery that every downstream product depends on.

**What you will own**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist
* Business focus: Build business strategy around ecosystem product that would define the success for the Razorpay and the Ecosystem players

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* You understand technology, but love customer-first & business-first thinking.
* You are comfortable working hands-on in a fast-paced start-up environment.
* You are curious about metrics, execution processes, macro trends.
* Problem-solving and detail orientation come naturally to you.
* You have an analytical and data-driven approach in day-to-day work. Energetic self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* You are entrepreneurial and have the hunger to solve problems end-to-end.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in Product Management.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Product-Tech, Central
jobs.description:
**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About This Role**
The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* Keep things documented: Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good To Have**

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:***
This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.
  
  
*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Product Owner - Finance AI
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**About Unilever**
Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.
  
  
Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.
  
  
**Role Purpose**

* Lead the design, delivery and adoption of AI solutions (GenAI, agentic AI and intelligent automation) across Finance processes.
* Turn Finance problems into AI use cases that can be audited and scaled, and that deliver measurable value.
* Make sure solutions meet clean-core, SOX and data governance standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Finance AI Use-Case Ownership
* Find and prioritise AI and automation opportunities across R2R, P2P, O2C, Treasury and FP&A .
* Build business cases with baseline KPIs: cycle time, manual effort, error rate and cost savings.
* Own the use-case backlog and roadmap, from proof of concept through MVP to scaled rollout.
* Solution Design & Delivery
* Work with Enterprise Architecture, HAP and vendor teams on how agents are designed: orchestration, context memory, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and confidence scoring.
* Define integration patterns between AI platforms (e.g., GCP Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio) and SAP S/4HANA or ECC .
* Write functional specs, prompt and rule logic, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Run delivery across the stage gates: Initiate → Plan → Build → Test → Deploy → Stabilise.
* Governance, Controls & Responsible AI
* Make sure AI outputs are explainable, traceable and ready for audit (logs, evidence, sign-offs, version history).
* Uphold SoD, access controls, data privacy and Responsible AI policies.
* Define how model performance and drift are monitored, plus exception handling and rollback.
* Vendor & Cost Management
* Challenge vendor estimates, separating reusable from use-case-specific components.
* Track budget, burn rate and SLAs, and measure benefits against the business case.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Adoption
* Work with Finance process owners, Controllership, Treasury, IT, Data and Audit teams.
* Present steerco updates, demos and value stories to senior leadership.
* Lead change management, user training and AI upskilling in Finance teams.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Can explain AI in Finance terms and Finance in AI terms.
* Delivery-focused and data-led, measuring outcomes rather than activity.
* Influences without authority across Finance, IT and vendors.
* Practical about innovation: tries standard features and the platform first, and builds custom only when needed.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Commerce, Finance or IT. CA/CMA/MBA (Finance) is a plus.
* AI certification preferred

**Success Measures**

* At least 2–3 Finance AI use cases live in production, with signed-off benefits.
* Measurable cut in manual effort and cycle time against baseline.
* No audit findings on deployed AI solutions.
* Higher adoption and AI skills across the Finance teams supported.

**Our commitment to Equality, Diversity & Inclusion**
Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.
  
  
**Note:**
*"All official offers from Unilever are issued only via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Offers from individuals or unofficial sources may be fraudulent—please verify before proceeding."*

jobs.title: Consultant, Product - Tech, Insight
jobs.description:
Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
This is a Consulting role for 3 - 6 months
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
**Founded**
with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
We build AI-first. Our engineers direct AI agents through most of the code they ship — planning with them, reviewing their output, and owning the result. If Claude Code, Cursor, or a similar agentic workflow isn't already central to how you work, this role won't be a fit. If it is, you'll feel at home on day one.

We're building agentic AI products that own entire workflows, not just answer questions. Our two products:
**Ozyn**
, an AI assistant that executes tasks across Gmail, CRM, Calendar, Sheets, and 50+ integrations — and
**Alvoff**
, a conversational procurement platform with agentic RAG and supplier intelligence serving buyers across 20+ industries. We practice what we build: our own development is AI-first, end to end.

**What you'll do**

You'll own features end-to-end across Ozyn and Alvoff: talk to users, scope the problem, build it, ship it, and watch how it lands. There are no handoffs between "product" and "engineering" here — you are both.

* Ship full-stack features with AI agents doing the bulk of implementation under your direction
* Talk directly to users and turn ambiguous problems into shipped product, often within days
* Set the bar for what AI-first development looks like — better prompts, better agent workflows, better review practices — and raise it as the tools evolve
* Make pragmatic calls on quality: knowing when agent output is good enough to ship and when it needs your hands on the keyboard
* Contribute to product direction, not just implementation. If you think we're building the wrong thing, we want to hear it

**How we work**

* **Agents write most of our code.**
  Your job is judgment: decomposing problems, directing agents, reviewing critically, and owning correctness. Typing speed is not the bottleneck; taste and decision speed are.
* **Small team, high ownership.**
  You'll ship to production in your first week.
* **Users over process.**
  We optimize for learning fast, not for ceremony.
* Open to candidates across India. The role is based in Bengaluru (on-site), and we welcome applicants from other cities who are open to relocating.

**What we're looking for**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals — you can evaluate and correct AI-generated code because you could have written it yourself
* A genuinely AI-native workflow today, not aspirationally. You have opinions about agent orchestration, context management, and where these tools break
* Product sense: you've shipped things users loved (or hated — and you learned why)
* Comfort with ambiguity and speed. You'd rather ship a v1 this week than a v3 next quarter
* 3+ years building production software, or a portfolio that makes years irrelevant

**Nice to have**

* Experience at an early-stage startup or as a founder
* You've built with LLM APIs (evals, agents, RAG) — useful, but note this role is about building
  *with*
  AI, and only sometimes building AI features
* Public evidence of how you work: repos, posts, tools you've built for yourself

jobs.title: Trading Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  

* The Full Stack Developer – Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users.
* Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using .NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities.
* The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer.

Key Accountabilities
  
  
**RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY:**
Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments.
  
  
**FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY:**
Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation.
  
  
**BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs:**
Develops .NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns.
  
  
**OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION:**
Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL.
  
  
**ENGINEERING QUALITY:**
Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY:**
Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions.
  
  
**COLLABORATION:**
Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements.
  
  
**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT:**
Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience delivery of user-facing reporting or analytics solutions, with proven ability to guide and mentor other engineers.
  
  
**Required Skills:**
**Mandatory:**

* Strong experience developing backend services using .NET
* Strong experience building frontend applications using React
* Hands-on experience with AgGrid for large, data-intensive reporting views
* Exposure to cloud-native deployment models and CI/CD pipelines

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working with risk, finance, or trading reporting platforms
* Experience consuming and querying OpenSearch for fast, flexible reporting and fuzzy filtering
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL-backed data solutions
* Experience coaching or mentoring engineers in a delivery-focused environment

How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.

Operating from our manufacturing facility at Himalayan Food Park in Kashipur with a daily production capacity of up to 5,00,000 bars, we partner with leading FMCG and nutrition brands to deliver products from concept to shelf.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on **Production Manager** to oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations at our Kashipur plant. You will lead daily shop-floor production across our sheet-and-cut, cold extrusion, baking, enrobing, and packaging lines while ensuring strict adherence to FSSAI, cGMP, and FSSC 22000 food safety standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Execution:** Plan, schedule, and execute daily and monthly production targets across multiple bar-manufacturing lines (30g–150g SKUs) to ensure on-time order fulfillment.
* **Process & Line Management:** Supervise specialized food processing operations including slab/sheet-and-cut, low-pressure cold extrusion, baking, chocolate/compound enrobing, and primary/secondary automated packaging.
* **Quality & Food Safety Compliance:** Enforce cGMP, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and FSSAI guidelines on the shop floor. Oversee critical control points including inline metal detection and check-weighing systems.
* **Yield Optimization & Waste Reduction:** Monitor raw material consumption, batch yields, and rework; implement lean manufacturing practices to minimize wastage and downtime.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, train, and manage shift supervisors, machine operators, and floor workers; oversee shift scheduling, attendance, and shop-floor discipline.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance (QA/QC), R&D (for new product trials and tech transfers), Maintenance, and Supply Chain/Stores teams to resolve bottlenecks smoothly.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Maintain accurate daily production logs, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics, batch manufacturing records (BMR), and audit documentation for client and regulatory inspections.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, or a related discipline.

OB DESCRIPTIONProject Manager – Nutraceutical Industry

**Company:** Sunshine Corporation (Brand: NoCheat) – Jolly Group of Companies  
**Location:** Rajkot, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Department:** Nutraceutical / FMCG  
**Experience:** 5+ Years Preferred  
**Salary:** No Bar for the Right Candidate  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

About the Company

Jolly Group of Companies is a diversified business group operating across multiple sectors, including textiles, real estate, oil recycling, insurance, FMCG, and nutraceuticals.

Under our brand **NoCheat**, we are expanding our nutraceutical business with innovative health, wellness, sports nutrition, beauty nutrition, and kids' nutrition products.

We are looking for an experienced **Nutraceutical Project Manager** to lead and manage product development projects from concept to successful commercial launch.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Project Planning & Management**

* Plan, execute, and monitor nutraceutical product development projects.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, resources, and deliverables.
* Coordinate multiple product launches simultaneously.
* Ensure timely completion of projects.

**2. Product Development & R&D Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D teams on product formulations and development.
* Coordinate development of powders, gummies, liquids, premixes, and other nutraceutical products.
* Oversee product trials, sampling, stability testing, and formulation approvals.
* Ensure product quality, effectiveness, and market suitability.

**3. Manufacturing & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with third-party manufacturers and contract manufacturing partners.
* Manage vendor selection, raw material sourcing, and packaging development.
* Monitor production schedules, manufacturing trials, and commercial batches.
* Ensure manufacturing quality and timely product delivery.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure products comply with applicable FSSAI regulations and other relevant standards.
* Coordinate product documentation, testing, certifications, and label approvals.
* Work with QA/QC teams to maintain product quality and safety.
* Ensure proper regulatory documentation before product launch.

**5. Product Launch & Commercialization**

* Manage end-to-end product commercialization.
* Coordinate with marketing, branding, packaging, purchase, and sales teams.
* Monitor packaging development, costing, and production readiness.
* Ensure successful product launches within approved timelines.

**6. Budget & Cost Management**

* Prepare and monitor project budgets.
* Control formulation, manufacturing, packaging, and development costs.
* Negotiate with suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality.

**7. Team Management & Reporting**

* Lead cross-functional teams, including R&D, Purchase, QA/QC, Production, and Marketing.
* Conduct regular project review meetings.
* Prepare project progress reports for senior management and the Managing Director.
* Identify project risks and implement corrective actions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Food Technology, Nutraceutical Science, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related field.
* MBA or Project Management certification will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, health supplements, or FMCG product development.
* Experience handling multiple product development and launch projects.
* Strong understanding of formulation development, manufacturing processes, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience working with third-party manufacturers.

Key Skills

* Project Management & Execution
* Nutraceutical Product Development
* R&D and Manufacturing Coordination
* FSSAI & Regulatory Knowledge
* Vendor & Supplier Management
* Product Launch Management
* Budgeting & Cost Optimization
* Leadership & Team Coordination
* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making
* Strong Communication & Reporting

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for a result-oriented professional who can independently manage nutraceutical projects from **product concept, formulation, sampling, testing, manufacturing, and packaging to final market launch**.

Candidates with experience in sports nutrition, kids' nutrition, beauty nutrition, and daily health supplements will be preferred.

Benefits

* Opportunity to work on a growing nutraceutical brand.

* Long-term career growth opportunities.

**Service Manager Job Description**

**1. Service Management**

* Develop and implement service policies, procedures, and standards to ensure consistency and efficiency
* Lead and supervise service technicians and service coordinator.
* Allocate service calls, installations, and preventive maintenance jobs(CMC).
* Monitor daily service activities, productivity, and discipline.
* Conduct technical training, safety training, and performance reviews.
* Ensure technicians follow SOPs, safety norms, and documentation standards.

**2. ERP Management (End-to-End)**

* Collect data for raising ticket, Designation, Phone number, Email ID, Machine Model, Serial Number, Complaint Description, Photo/ Video.
* Raise quotation based on the approval/ payment conformation, allot service technician as per the availability, competency, location and criticality of service.
* Ensure **job cards are raised accurately** for all service calls from Customer, Project team, and Sales team. (installation, breakdown, PM, AMC/CMC).
* Review job card details including complaint description, parts used, labour, travel, and service status.
* Ensure service reports are attached with job card.

**3. Coordination & Service Scheduling**

* Work closely with the **Service Coordinator** to:
* Receive service requests and log complaints.
* Schedule technicians and site visits.
* Track job status and escalation.

**4. Spare Parts & Warranty Control**

* Approve spare parts usage as per warranty/AMC/chargeable conditions.
* Monitor spare consumption against job cards.
* Ensure defective parts are returned and handed over properly to concern department.
* Coordinate with stores for inventory reconciliation.

**5. Billing & Payment Coordination (PI to Payment)**

* Review & Approve the Performa invoice and ensure all commercial documentation was completed.
* Verify completed job cards for **billing eligibility** (Warranty, AMC/CMC, out-of-warranty calls).
* Ensure timely submission of approved Performa Invoice to accounts for invoicing.
* Coordinate with accounts and service coordinator to track invoices.
* Follow up with customers for payment realization and resolve service-related billing queries.
* Ensure closure of service tickets only after payment confirmation.

\*

**6. Customer Relationship & Escalation Handling**

* Act as escalation point for service-related customer issues.
* Ensure professional communication with hospitals.
* Review customer feedback and take corrective actions.

**7. Compliance, Quality & Documentation**

* Maintain service reports, installation certificates, and AMC logs.
* Support audits and regulatory inspections related to service operations.

**8. Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Require to share Weekly Service Call Report & Weekly Installation Report to MD.
* Analyse repeat complaints, response time, closure efficiency on Monthly Service Call Report & Monthly Installation Report.
* Require to share Monthly Service Call Report & Monthly Installation Report to MD after review.
* Identify recurring technical issues and provide feedback to R&D and production teams.
* Improve service efficiency, cost control, and customer satisfaction.

Language Preferences: English, Hindi & Tamil

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

* total work: 10 years (Preferred)

Inside Sales Executive – FMCG / Food & Beverage

**Location:** Taramani Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Industry:** FMCG / Food & Beverage / Food Processing / Nutraceuticals / Consumer Products

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and target-oriented **Inside Sales Executive** to generate business opportunities, engage prospective clients and support revenue growth through outbound calls, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach and inbound enquiry management.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers across the FMCG, food and beverage, nutraceutical, food processing and consumer products industries and introducing them to our company's services.

The role involves understanding customer requirements, explaining our service offerings, qualifying leads, scheduling meetings and nurturing prospects throughout the sales cycle.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, confidence in making outbound calls, strong follow-up abilities and an interest in the food, FMCG and consumer products industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Inside Sales & Lead Conversion**

* Handle inbound business enquiries received through the company website, email, LinkedIn and other marketing channels.
* Conduct outbound calls to prospective B2B clients.
* Introduce company services and identify potential business opportunities.
* Explain services related to food product development, formulation, R&D, pilot manufacturing, contract manufacturing and commercialization.
* Understand customer requirements and identify suitable service offerings.
* Convert enquiries into qualified sales opportunities.
* Nurture prospects through regular calls, emails and follow-ups.
* Work towards achieving monthly sales and conversion targets.

**2. Lead Generation & Prospecting**

* Identify potential customers in the FMCG, food and beverage, nutraceutical and food processing industries.

* Identify relevant decision-makers such as:

* Product Development Managers
* Procurement Managers
* Business Development Heads
* Production and Operations Managers
* Conduct initial conversations to understand client requirements.
* Qualify prospects based on project requirements, budget, business potential and timelines.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective customers.

* Explain company capabilities, services and business solutions to potential customers.
* Understand customer requirements related to new product development, food formulation, product improvement and manufacturing.
* Follow up with prospects regarding enquiries, proposals, quotations and ongoing discussions.
* Schedule meetings between prospective clients and the business development or technical teams.
* Maintain professional relationships with prospects and existing customers.
* Ensure timely responses to customer enquiries.
* Re-engage inactive leads and follow up on previously contacted prospects.

* Food R&D and innovation.
* Functional food and beverage development.
* Nutraceutical and health product development.
* Pilot-scale product development.
* Contract manufacturing and private-label solutions.
* Food testing and quality-related services.
* Food regulatory and compliance support.
* Ingredient sourcing and product commercialization.

The candidate should be able to communicate the basic value proposition of these services and coordinate with technical teams for detailed discussions.

**5. Sales Coordination & Proposal Support**

* Coordinate with business development, R&D, formulation and technical teams.
* Understand client project requirements and communicate them internally.
* Assist in preparing basic proposals, quotations and presentations.
* Schedule technical discussions and client meetings.
* Follow up on proposals and quotations to move prospects towards conversion.
* Maintain communication with clients throughout the sales process.
* Support smooth client onboarding after successful conversion.

**6. CRM & Sales Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, emails, follow-ups and sales opportunities.
* Update CRM systems with prospect details and communication history.
* Track lead status, enquiry sources, meeting schedules and conversions.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales activity reports.
* Monitor call performance, lead qualification and conversion rates.
* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.
* Share regular sales updates with the reporting manager.

**Target Client Segments**

The candidate will engage with prospective clients from:

* Food and beverage manufacturers.
* Packaged food companies.
* Beverage and functional drink brands.
* Dairy and dairy-based product manufacturers.
* Snacks, bakery and confectionery companies.
* Ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook food brands.

* Health and wellness startups.

* Food processing companies.

**Required Skills**

* Confidence in making outbound calls and handling customer conversations.
* Strong inside sales and lead generation capabilities.

* Ability to understand customer requirements and qualify business leads.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Quality
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Assistant Manager Quality Assurance (QA/QC)**
-----------------------------------------------

**Location:** Silvassa

**Department:** Quality Control (QC)

**Qualification:** Diploma / CIPET / B.E.

**Experience:** 710 Years

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Assistant Manager Quality Assurance to lead and manage Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities across manufacturing operations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, process compliance, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality management and food safety standards, including ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage and oversee all Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities across manufacturing operations.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and applicable quality and food safety standards.
* Handle customer and supplier quality requirements, complaints, and quality-related concerns.
* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and 8D problem-solving activities.
* Implement and monitor FMEA, the 7 QC Tools, and other quality improvement methodologies.
* Plan and conduct internal audits, customer audits, supplier audits, and product traceability audits.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
* Monitor and ensure effective implementation of Control Plans, PRP, OPRP, CCP, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Ensure proper functional testing, inspection, and validation of products and processes.
* Maintain quality documentation, inspection reports, test records, SOPs, and audit-related documents.
* Monitor product quality at incoming, in-process, and final inspection stages.
* Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, R&D, and other departments to resolve quality-related issues.
* Ensure proper utilization, calibration, and maintenance of laboratory testing equipment.
* Develop and implement quality improvement plans to reduce rejection, customer complaints, and process deviations.

**Required Skills & Competencies**
----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000 standards.
* Hands-on experience in RCA, CAPA, 8D, and FMEA.
* Good understanding of the 7 QC Tools and statistical quality control.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Lean Six Sigma.
* Understanding of PRP, OPRP, CCP, Control Plans, and SPC.
* Experience in internal audits, customer audits, and supplier audits.
* Knowledge of laboratory testing equipment and functional testing procedures.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**
------------------------

**Qualification:** Diploma / CIPET / B.E. in a relevant technical discipline.

**Experience:** 710 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. You will become a part of India’s proudest legacy, a brand that is celebrated by **130 million Indians** and is now taking over the world with its manufacturing superpower.

**Company:** CEV Engineering  
**Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.
* Evaluate dealer technicians' technical knowledge and capabilities.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly field issue reports.
* Maintain a technical complaint database and track issue closure.
* Prepare 8D reports, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective Action Reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.
* Present technical performance and improvement plans to management.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM Quality, Service, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support new vehicle launches and CNG system validation activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for spare parts availability and technical support.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of CNG vehicle systems and components.
* Knowledge of CNG regulators, injectors, pressure sensors, cylinders, HP tubes, and fittings.
* Understanding of CNG diagnostics and scanning tools.
* Knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Understanding of warranty processes and quality tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D).
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and technical reporting.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.
* Number of dealer technical training sessions conducted.
* Improvement in first-time-right repair performance.
* Reduction in unnecessary part replacement.

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Team management and leadership abilities.

* Timely resolution of CNG field issues.
* Improved dealer technical capabilities.

R&D Team Manager

* Understanding of Industrial Cybersecurity (IEC 62443), automated testing practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and Agile software development methodologies is considered an advantage.

ABB's Process Industries business serves customers across mining, minerals, metals, cement, pulp & paper, battery manufacturing, food & beverage, and other industrial sectors by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.

jobs.title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager for Application Lab of Personal Care & Home Care
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Application Lab Senior Executive / Assistant Manager develops tests and demonstrates personal care and home care formulations that showcase the company's principals' ingredients. The role bridges suppliers, sales teams and customers, turning raw material know-how into practical formulations, technical data and compelling presentations.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Skin Care Formulations

* Develop and optimise skin care prototypes – creams, lotions, serums, gels, sun care, cleansers and colour cosmetic bases – using the principals' emulsifiers, emollients, actives, UV filters, rheology modifiers, preservatives and sensory additives.
* Create benchmark and starting-point formulations that showcase ingredient performance, stability and sensory.
* Adapt customer formulas for ingredient substitution, cost optimisation, sustainability or regulatory change.
* Work on natural, vegan and clean beauty concepts in line with market trends.

2. Hair Care Formulations

* Develop shampoos, conditioners, masks, leave-on treatments, styling products, colorants and scalp-care formulations.
* Evaluate surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones and alternatives, and actives for claims such as anti-dandruff, repair, frizz control and colour protection.
* Run sulphate-free, silicone-free and bio-based formulation projects.

3. Home Care Support

* Support home care formulations (laundry, dishwash, surface and fabric care) as business needs require.

4. Testing and Performance Evaluation

* Test physico-chemical parameters: pH, viscosity, appearance, colour, odour, foam, SPF/UV and droplet size.
* Run stability (accelerated, freeze-thaw, light, centrifuge), compatibility and preservative efficacy studies, coordinating with external labs where needed.
* Conduct sensory panels and in-vitro/in-vivo claim support studies, including hair-tress and skin-feel evaluations.
* Maintain and calibrate lab instruments; ensure GLP, safety and housekeeping.

5. Innovation and Trend Monitoring

* Track global personal care trends, launches, regulations and competitor products; convert insights into concept formulations.
* Collaborate with principals on new ingredient launches and co-development projects.
* Propose new product concepts and sustainable, value-added solutions for the regional market.
* Capture market and consumer trends from market visits, customers, retail and competitor products; share insights and opportunity reports with sales, marketing and principals.

6. Trade Shows, Events and Customer Engagement

* Prepare and present formulations, samples and demo material at trade shows and conferences (e.g., in-cosmetics, HPCI, CHT, local exhibitions).
* Support technical seminars, lab tours and live application demonstrations.
* Support the sales team on customer visits, in person and virtual (video calls, online demos, webinars), with technical inputs, formulation discussions and follow-up.
* Join sales on market visits to brand owners, contract manufacturers and trade partners to understand requirements and opportunities.
* Provide technical troubleshooting to customers on formulation, stability, processing and performance issues – identify root causes and recommend corrective solutions.

7. Documentation

* Maintain accurate lab notebooks, formulation records, batch sheets and test reports.
* Prepare technical data sheets, formulation brochures, application notes and product dossiers with full traceability.
* Support sales and principals with technical documents, test data, certificates and customer queries.
* Support regulatory and compliance documentation (SDS, claims support, BIS, ISO 22716/GMP).
* Support sampling: prepare, label, pack and dispatch samples; track requests, feedback and conversions.
* Manage the formulation database, sample inventory and retention-sample library.

8. Presentations and Technical Communication

* Deliver technical presentations to customers, internal teams and principals, covering formulation results and project updates.
* Present case studies and performance data with clear visuals.
* Develop product application training for sales teams.
* Work with marketing on digital campaigns (webinars, e-mailers, social media, online content) and promotional material (brochures, flyers, application videos, case studies), ensuring technical accuracy.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* M.Sc / B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Pharm / M.Pharm in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Oils & Surfactants, Chemical or Pharmaceutical Technology.

**Experience**

* Senior Executive: 3–6 years; Assistant Manager: 6–10 years in personal care formulation (skin and hair care), in a lab, application or R&D role – preferably with a raw material supplier or distributor.
* Hands-on experience in emulsions, surfactant systems, sun care and hair care.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of cosmetic ingredients, INCI, stability and regulatory basics.
* Excellent presentation, communication and customer-facing skills.
* Proficient in MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel; formulation software is a plus.
* Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Collaborative, curious and innovative; willing to travel for trade shows and customer visits.

Works closely with Personal Care and Home Care sales and marketing, principals' technical teams, customers, and regulatory and quality functions.

**Job Description:** Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

jobs.title: Head PreClinical- Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology
jobs.description:
VENUS MEDICINE RESEARCH CENTRE (VMRC)

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

jobs.description:
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!

**At CEEW, we build careers in public policy**

* We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale
* We actively promote leadership by initiative
* We celebrate talent and ambition
* You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow
* You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations
* Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility, come together at CEEW
* You will get above-market remuneration
* We provide a safe space for all
* At CEEW, your life is your example for others

**Designation offered**
  
Senior Programme Lead

**Reporting to**
  
Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)

**Location**
  
New Delhi, India

### **Purpose**

Systems change in food systems reform is impeded by entrenched political economy dynamics. We are looking for a leader who can not only navigate this political economy, but also orchestrate difficult, real change – rewriting political economy equations and enabling systemic transformation. They will build and lead a team working at the interface of political economy, public policy, and institutions, and will advance the Council’s research, policy engagement, and impact by helping the programme understand and navigate political economy while actively orchestrating systems-level change in India’s food systems.

### **Responsibilities and Duties**

**Strategy**

* Co-evolve the strategy for the programme’s political economy work, building on existing in-house thinking, the political economy landscape across food systems reform, our skillset and niche, the evolving sectoral narrative, and emerging government priorities.
* Work closely with the team to bring alignment within the team on the strategy.
* Build a network of contacts across government, political leadership, and public institutions to create sustained pathways for policy and institutional change.
* Spearhead coalition building with public institutions, political leadership, and civil society partners, in coordination with internal project streams, creating a high-leverage venue for catalytic action on political economy transitions.
* Lead the thinking on how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making in food systems; scope and develop new ideas and programmes to shift this political economy towards sustainability transitions.

### **Research**

* Lead research and intelligence-gathering on the political economy of food systems reform, including the role of institutions, regulatory environments, incentives, and narratives in shaping decision-making.
* Develop intelligence and strategies to shape the political economy of food systems towards sustainability transitions, and identify levers and entry points for orchestrating change.
* Map stakeholders, interests, and power structures across government, political leadership, and public institutions relevant to food systems reform, ensuring alignment and collaborative execution.
* Lead research in the programme area as a principal investigator. Guide and provide relevant inputs to the wider research agenda.
* Assess and improve existing methodologies and frameworks employed by SFS relevant to political economy analysis, and build institutional capacity on such methodologies.
* Keep a tab on policy and political developments in agriculture and food systems.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

***ProV Foods is an integrated healthy foods conglomerate based in Mumbai, specializing in dry fruits and staples.
