jobs.title: Manager Engineering
jobs.description:
**About Us**
talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50+ countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About this role:**
We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real-time tracking and payments.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
  
  
We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this way.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat

**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days**
: You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
  
  
**By 6 months**
: Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
  
  
**By 12 months**
: You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**You must have**

* 6+ years of hands-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross-platform)
* 2+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade-offs between native vs cross-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data

**Bonus If You Have**

* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) or event-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams

**This role is for you if...**

* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought

**This role is NOT for you if...**

**Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.

jobs.title: Manager, Nutrition, Health and Wellness
jobs.description:
POSITION VACANCY
  
  
Manager Nutrition Health & Wellness
  
  
POSITION SNAPSHOT
  
  
Company: Nestlé
  
  
Location: Dubai - HQ
  
  
**Position Summary**
Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.
  
  
As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.
  
  
A DAY IN THE LIFE …
  
  

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.
* Define desired nutritional profile for target population. Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. Validate final product’s nutritional criteria & composition.
* Identify nutrition gaps & opportunities for portfolio evolution & growth. Understands and articulates the nutrition reality to drive the identification of nutritional needs and gaps in portfolio. Collation of nutrition science, nutrition landscaping, knowledge on key insights from consumer data, competitive analysis, and global and local trends, translate relevant nutrition knowledge into competitive and feasible product concepts and solutions.
* Acts as the local nutrition partner to local marketing teams, translating portfolio, competitive, consumer and scientific insights into nutrition recommendations supporting category and brand priorities. Liaising with cross-functional teams and global Nestlé innovation and R&D centers.
* Provide substantiation behind nutrition or health claims development. Deploy nutrition and health claims positively evaluated by scientific authorities and /or by Nestlé Health Claim Panel in line with business and brand strategy, guide claims within I/R process. Develop scientific substantiation for market driven nutrition & health claims: e.g. write a scientific rationale document for health claims to be evaluated by global strategic teams & Nestlé Health Claims Panel.
* Brings science-based nutrition insights to inspire innovation and build credible, compelling communication stories.
* Trains and engages market employees and marketers on nutrition and contributes to the internal capability agenda and the Nutritionists Community.
* External KOL/ authorities engagement. May represent the organization at different nutrition forums and convenings, including food industry/technical working groups. Content provider and/or a spoke-person for nutritional advocacy topics externally for categories of responsibility. Acts as a key nutrition advisor at any level and understand the areas of opportunities of positive impact and risks within the external nutrition environment, the Food Industry and Public Health environment

What will make you successful…
  
  

* University Degree; Masters in Nutrition/Dietetics, Food science and technology with nutrition specialization)
* 2–5 years of experience as a nutritionist in the food industry, public health or an academic environment.
* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.
* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.
* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.
* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.
* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.
* Project management skils and ability to work in matrix organizations.
* Fluency in Arabic is required; proficiency in French is an advantage.

**The Role**

You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****
**What Did We Order?**
****Technical Experience****

* Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, and data mining.
* Hands-on knowledge of ML and GenAI frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and LLM fine-tuning.
* Proficiency with the OpenAI SDK and familiarity with major LLM provider APIs for building and orchestrating production AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph for building stateful, multi-step agentic workflows and complex agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with Hugging Face (Transformers, Hub, Inference API) for model sourcing, fine-tuning, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of embeddings, dense and sparse retrieval, vector databases, and semantic search, for building RAG pipelines and similarity-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean production code, data structures and algorithms, ML system design.
* Proven experience shipping and monitoring ML models in production, with a solid grasp of MLOps practices.
* Strong data and ML engineering skills: building and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow) and robust feature engineering.
* Excellent SQL and Python; solid statistical foundations including experiment design, causal inference, and predictive methods.
* Familiarity with agentic system design (harness-first thinking, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and production feedback loops) is a strong plus.
* Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A postgraduate degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, and/or generative AI, including shipping models to production.
* 2+ years managing or leading a data science or ML team, with a track record of developing talent and delivering through others.
* Experience building ML systems in an online consumer product environment is a strong plus.

****Additional Information****
Mindset & Ways of Working
  
  

* Curiosity over certainty: you're excited to try the new model or framework this week.
* Ownership: you treat cost, latency, and business impact as your problem, and your team's.
* Bias to build: a prototype in a real workflow beats a perfect design doc every time.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: most of what we build has no playbook yet, and you help write it.
* Keep it simple: pick the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity, and #makeithappen.

**At talabat, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters, and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.**

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Head Chef will be responsible for overseeing all kitchen operations, ensuring consistent food quality, maintaining high standards of food presentation, managing kitchen staff, controlling food costs, and ensuring compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations.

The role requires strong culinary expertise, leadership capabilities, creativity, and the ability to manage kitchen operations efficiently while ensuring customer satisfaction and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Kitchen Operations & Food Production:**

* Oversee and manage all daily kitchen operations.
* Ensure timely preparation and delivery of food orders.
* Maintain consistency in food quality, taste, portion sizes, and presentation.
* Develop and implement standard recipes and food preparation procedures.
* Ensure all dishes are prepared according to company standards.
* Monitor kitchen workflow and ensure efficient coordination between kitchen sections.
* Introduce new dishes, seasonal menus, and innovative food concepts.
* Ensure proper utilization of kitchen equipment and facilities.

**Menu Planning & Development:**

* Develop, review, and update food menus in coordination with management.
* Create new recipes and improve existing dishes.
* Conduct food trials and tastings before introducing new menu items.
* Ensure menu pricing is aligned with food costs and profitability targets.
* Monitor food trends and introduce innovative culinary ideas.
* Ensure menu items meet customer expectations and brand standards.

**Team Management & Leadership:**

* Recruit, train, supervise, and develop kitchen employees.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities among kitchen staff.
* Prepare kitchen duty rosters and manage staff scheduling.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Conduct regular training on cooking techniques, food safety, and hygiene.
* Maintain teamwork, discipline, and a positive working environment.
* Identify training needs and support employee development.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels across all kitchen sections.

**Food Cost & Inventory Management:**

* Monitor food costs and ensure achievement of budgeted targets.
* Control food wastage, spoilage, and unnecessary expenses.
* Monitor stock levels and coordinate purchasing requirements.
* Ensure proper receiving, storage, and rotation of food items.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and stocktaking.
* Establish appropriate portion control and standard recipes.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure quality and competitive pricing.
* Monitor kitchen expenses and recommend cost-saving measures.

**Food Safety & Hygiene:**

* Ensure strict compliance with UAE food safety regulations and applicable municipal requirements.
* Maintain high standards of kitchen cleanliness and sanitation.
* Ensure proper food handling, preparation, storage, and temperature control.
* Monitor expiry dates and implement FIFO (First In, First Out) procedures.
* Conduct regular kitchen hygiene and safety inspections.
* Ensure staff follow personal hygiene and grooming standards.
* Maintain food safety records and inspection documentation.
* Take immediate corrective action in case of hygiene or food safety violations.

**Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction:**

* Conduct regular food quality checks before dishes are served.
* Ensure consistency in taste, texture, temperature, and presentation.
* Handle food-related customer complaints professionally.
* Coordinate with restaurant service teams to ensure smooth food delivery.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement necessary improvements.
* Ensure all special dietary requirements and food allergies are handled appropriately.

**Equipment & Maintenance:**

* Ensure kitchen equipment is maintained in good working condition.
* Report equipment breakdowns and coordinate timely repairs.
* Ensure proper use and handling of kitchen tools and machinery.
* Monitor kitchen safety procedures and prevent workplace accidents.
* Maintain organized storage areas and kitchen workstations.

**Administration & Reporting:**

* Prepare daily and monthly kitchen operational reports.
* Monitor food cost percentages, wastage, and inventory consumption.
* Maintain recipe cards, food costing sheets, and kitchen records.
* Report operational challenges and staffing requirements to management.
* Assist management with budgeting and operational planning.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and standard operating procedures.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in professional kitchen operations.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a Head Chef or Sous Chef role.
* Strong experience in menu development, food costing, and kitchen management.
* Knowledge of international cuisines and modern cooking techniques.
* Good understanding of UAE food safety regulations.
* Experience in managing and developing multicultural kitchen teams.
* Previous UAE experience is a must.

jobs.title: Executive Pastry Chef
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Executive Pastry Chef is responsible for leading the creation, development and execution of premium pastry and dessert concepts across Independent Food Company's portfolio, including the development and launch of new pastry brands.

The role combines brand creation, culinary innovation, product development and operational leadership, ensuring that each concept delivers a distinctive identity, exceptional product quality, commercial viability and a consistent guest experience.

The incumbent will lead the end-to-end culinary development of new pastry brands, from initial concept creation and menu development through kitchen design and layout planning, recipe standardization, equipment selection, team recruitment, training and successful operational launch.

While the role carries strategic and creative responsibilities, the Executive Pastry Chef must remain fully hands-on, actively participating in product development, tastings, production trials, training and new brand openings.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pastry Brand Creation & Concept Development**

1. Lead the culinary creation and development of new pastry, bakery and dessert brands, from initial concept ideation through commercial launch.

2. Collaborate with Brand Development, Marketing, Design and Operations to establish each brand's culinary identity, positioning, product offering and guest experience.

3. Develop distinctive pastry concepts aligned with market opportunities, consumer preferences, international trends and business objectives.

4. Define the product strategy, menu architecture and signature offerings for each new concept.

5. Lead the development of pastry kitchen designs and layouts, defining production workflows, equipment positioning, preparation areas, storage requirements and operational efficiency in collaboration with Design and Projects teams.

6. Define kitchen equipment requirements and technical specifications, ensuring layouts support the proposed menu, production capacity, quality standards and future scalability.

7. Participate in concept development workshops, product presentations, tastings and management approval processes.

8. Ensure proposed concepts are commercially viable, operationally scalable and aligned with approved business plans and investment budgets.

jobs.title: Manager Culinary Development

Join our Catering team, where you will be part of an exciting business area that plays a vital role in delivering the Emirates ‘Fly Better’ experience. This team is responsible for a wide range of food and non-food functions, including catering, equipment, and amenities for inflight dining and special events.

If you are passionate about culinary excellence, logistics, and delivering world-class service, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As a key part of our Service Delivery operations, our catering team makes crucial decisions that enhance the customer experience and elevate our growing global brand.

As a **Manager Culinary Development,** you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.

Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.

**Experience:**

* Deep expertise in recipe development, standardisation, and large-scale recipe upscaling.

jobs.title: Manager, Nutrition, Health and Wellness
jobs.description:
POSITION VACANCY

Manager Nutrition Health & Wellness

POSITION SNAPSHOT

Company: Nestlé

Location: Dubai - HQ

POSITION SUMMARY

Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.

A DAY IN THE LIFE …

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.

* Define desired nutritional profile for target population. Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. Validate final product’s nutritional criteria & composition.

* Identify nutrition gaps & opportunities for portfolio evolution & growth. Understands and articulates the nutrition reality to drive the identification of nutritional needs and gaps in portfolio. Collation of nutrition science, nutrition landscaping, knowledge on key insights from consumer data, competitive analysis, and global and local trends, translate relevant nutrition knowledge into competitive and feasible product concepts and solutions.

* Acts as the local nutrition partner to local marketing teams, translating portfolio, competitive, consumer and scientific insights into nutrition recommendations supporting category and brand priorities. Liaising with cross-functional teams and global Nestlé innovation and R&D centers.

* Provide substantiation behind nutrition or health claims development. Deploy nutrition and health claims positively evaluated by scientific authorities and /or by Nestlé Health Claim Panel in line with business and brand strategy, guide claims within I/R process. Develop scientific substantiation for market driven nutrition & health claims: e.g. write a scientific rationale document for health claims to be evaluated by global strategic teams & Nestlé Health Claims Panel.

* Brings science-based nutrition insights to inspire innovation and build credible, compelling communication stories.

* Trains and engages market employees and marketers on nutrition and contributes to the internal capability agenda and the Nutritionists Community.

* External KOL/ authorities engagement. May represent the organization at different nutrition forums and convenings, including food industry/technical working groups. Content provider and/or a spoke-person for nutritional advocacy topics externally for categories of responsibility. Acts as a key nutrition advisor at any level and understand the areas of opportunities of positive impact and risks within the external nutrition environment, the Food Industry and Public Health environment

What will make you successful…

* University Degree; Masters in Nutrition/Dietetics, Food science and technology with nutrition specialization)

* 2–5 years of experience as a nutritionist in the food industry, public health or an academic environment.

* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.

* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.

* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.

* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.

* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.

* Project management skils and ability to work in matrix organizations.

* Fluency in Arabic is required; proficiency in French is an advantage.

We are on a journey to A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World. A world where smokers who would otherwise continue to smoke, have migrated to smokeless alternatives. Join us at BAT, where purpose meets possibility, and your career story unfolds.

---------------------

Building a Smokeless World is no small feat—it’s fueled by the collective efforts of talented individuals, each bringing their unique perspective. This is the most innovative chapter in BAT’s history, and you can help shape it.

Strategy and Purpose Brand and Innovation

**Scientific Engagement Manager**
---------------------------------

jobs.title: Technical Service and Nutrionist
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.
* Act as the regional focal point for complex or high-value technical customer requirements that go beyond routine local support.
* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.
* Build technical capability within sales and technical teams through coaching, training, field support and reusable technical tools.
* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in the Animal Health and Nutrition industry, with substantial exposure to technical service, animal nutrition, feed applications or related work.
* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.
* Secondary location: Dubai.
* Hybrid work mode.
* Regional scope covering all three MEIA subregions.
* Travel requirement: approximately 40–50% across MEIA, in line with business needs.

**Relevant information**
This is an individual contributor position within Technical Service / Animal Nutrition, with responsibility across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA).
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

The research group of Prof. Sunil Kumar in the Division of Engineering, New York University Abu Dhabi, seeks to recruit a Research Scientist to conduct research in the area of microfluidic devices. Applicants with a background in cell biology, bioengineering, tissue engineering, or translational medicine are encouraged to apply. Terms of employment include competitive salary and benefits.
  
  
Research in Prof. Kumar’s Lab focuses on developing paper based microfluidic platforms for translational medicine applications, including immunoassays and cell migration assays, cell culture applications and disease diagnosis, as well as new methods for spheroid and organoid culture for drug testing. Our projects are highly interdisciplinary and require collaboration with chemistry, biology, and engineering faculty.
  
  
The applicant must be able to independently design, plan, and carry out research project tasks, co-mentor doctoral researchers, write journal and conference papers, conduct experiments and analyze data, as well as manage day-to-day functioning of the lab.
  
  
Applicants must have a PhD with at least 6 years of relevant experience in mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, biology, biotechnology, or virology, and significant experience with experimentation, design of experiments, and data analysis, including cell culture studies.
  
  
To be considered, all applicants must submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, transcript of degree / copy of highest degree, research statement, and at least 2 contact references.
  
  
Applications will be accepted immediately. candidates will be considered until the position is filled. If you have any questions, please reach out to: sunil.kumar@nyu.edu.

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatician
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Overview**
M42 is a global health champion powered by artificial intelligence (AI), technology and genomics to advance innovation in health for people and the planet. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, M42 combines its specialized, state-of-the-art facilities with integrated health solutions like genomics and biobanks, and harnesses advanced technologies to deliver precise, preventive and predictive care, to disrupt traditional healthcare models and positively impact lives globally.
  
  
The Senior Bioinformatician will join a large genomics and bioinformatics team supporting the Emirati Genome Program (EGP), a national-scale whole genome sequencing initiative. The role is responsible for leading the development, optimization, and automation of large-scale genomic data processing workflows, ensuring reliable, scalable, and reproducible analysis across diverse sequencing technologies. The position contributes to the advancement of production genomics capabilities through workflow innovation, cloud-based computing solutions, quality control frameworks, and continuous improvement of bioinformatics infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable bioinformatics pipelines and workflows for large-scale genomic data processing.
* Build and optimize automated workflows for sequencing quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, and downstream genomic analyses.
* Develop and manage workflow orchestration platforms such as Nextflow and equivalent workflow management systems.
* Improve workflow scalability, reproducibility, monitoring, performance, and reliability across high-volume sequencing datasets.
* Evaluate, benchmark, and integrate new bioinformatics tools, sequencing technologies, and analytical approaches into production environments.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, performance bottlenecks, data quality issues, and unexpected analytical results.
* Support harmonization of genomic data across sequencing platforms, software versions, pipelines, callers, and data releases.
* Apply best practices in genomic quality control, including assessment of sequencing metrics, sample integrity, contamination, variant quality, batch effects, and cohort release criteria.
* Contribute to cloud-based genomic computing environments, containerization technologies, workload optimization, and reproducible software deployment practices.
* Collaborate with scientists, bioinformaticians, software engineers, platform teams, cloud specialists, and data management teams to deliver technical and scientific objectives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of production genomics workflows and operational processes.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, data governance requirements, confidentiality standards, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Document workflows, technical processes, and validation activities to support reproducibility and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Significant experience in production bioinformatics, genomic computing, workflow development, cloud genomics, or related technical fields.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale genomics infrastructure, pipeline development, or workflow automation projects.
* Experience working with whole genome sequencing (WGS) datasets and large-scale genomic analysis environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms, workflow orchestration frameworks, and high-performance computing environments is strongly preferred.
* Scientific publications, open-source contributions, or ownership of large-scale genomics systems are advantageous.
* Strong programming skills in Python, shell scripting, or related languages.
* Advanced Linux command-line proficiency.
* Experience with Nextflow or similar workflow orchestration frameworks.
* Knowledge of genomic processing tools such as DRAGEN, Sentieon, GATK, bcftools, samtools, and related technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Singularity/Apptainer, containerized workflows, and reproducible software environments.
* Strong understanding of genomic file formats including FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, and gVCF.
* Expertise in genomic quality control, variant calling, structural variation analysis, and large-scale genomic data processing.
* Familiarity with Git, software version control, and workflow testing practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary technical and scientific teams.

The position plays a key role in promoting a culture of food safety excellence, operational consistency, and continuous improvement while ensuring the highest standards of hygiene and customer satisfaction are maintained.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

* Conduct routine quality and hygiene inspections across all operational areas.
* Monitor compliance with company SOPs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify non-conformities and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist in reviewing, updating, and implementing quality management procedures.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.

jobs.description:
Agriculture Subsidy Redesign, Targeting, and Impact

**Role purpose**

Design and implement subsidies and incentive mechanisms that improve productivity, sustainability, and farmer livelihoods while ensuring
**fiscal sustainability, compliance, and measurable impact**
. This role is a technical lead within the TMO portfolio and owns the end-to-end subsidy reform workstream.

**Responsibilities:**

**Diagnosis and design**

* Map existing subsidy landscape: eligibility, spend, leakage risks,incentive distortions, overlaps.
* Segment beneficiaries (farm types, size,crop/livestock systems, geography, vulnerability).
* Design alternative subsidy models:
* Targeted input subsidies (seed/feed/fertilizer) with controls
* Outcome/conditionality-linked incentives (water efficiency, compliance, productivity)
* Capital grants/ co-investment schemesfor modernization (irrigation, greenhouses, renewables)
* Develop fiscalscenarios and trade-offs for government decision-makers.

**Targeting, eligibility, and controls**

* Define eligibility rules, verification methods,and audit trails(registry integration, land/farm ID, production evidence).
* Design leakageprevention controls (claimsvalidation, supplier vetting,anomaly detection triggers).
* Develop compliance mechanisms and enforcement pathways aligned with regulations.
* Develop cost-benefit scenarios to define and review on an ongoing basis applicability of the subsidies.

**Implementation of architecture**

* Translate designinto executable implementation plan: policy drafts,operating procedures, system requirements, vendor/process changes.
* Work with digital/data teamson:
* Farmer registryintegration
* e-voucher / digital disbursement logic
* Case management workflows for exceptions and appeals
* Support procurement packages (system integrators, payment rails, verification services).

**Monitoring and impactevaluation framework**

* Define an impact evaluation approach:
* Logic models(inputs → outputs→ outcomes)
* Baselines and measurement methods(surveys, remote sensingproxies, administrative data)
* Quasi-experimental designoptions were feasible(phased rollout, comparison groups)
* Establish a benefits trackingdiscipline within the TMO (impactreporting cadence, auditability).

**Stakeholder management**

* Coordinate with finance/treasury, audit,regulators, farmer associations, suppliers, and service providers.
* Develop communication materials to supportadoption and managepolitical economic risks.

The role provides day-to-day delivery and analytical support within the TMO across a defined set of programs and workstreams, with a focus on execution discipline, quality of analysis, and reliable follow-through. jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison
jobs.description:
**Location: Northeast**

**Territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI**

If you are interested in the below position, please send your resume to careers@tgtxinc.com and REFERENCE THE POSITION TITLE within the subject line.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

Key Responsibilities

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert
* Fair-balanced scientific engagement across the assigned geography; establishes and maintains relationships with KOLs, HCPs, clinics and institutions, payers, and other stakeholders within the MG area
* Responsive and engages regularly with thought leaders and external stakeholders
* Collaborate and support Clinical Development and Clinical Operations research initiatives including site identification and trial recruitment
* Partner with clinical trial sites to optimize patient recruitment strategies, leveraging both data-driven insights and relationship-building
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs—to troubleshoot recruitment challenges and streamline processes
* Monitor site performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve enrollment rates.
* Support investigator meetings, site initiation visits, and ongoing trial communications
* Maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements and company SOPs while fostering trust and transparency with stakeholders
* Supports Medical Affairs initiatives (advisory board meetings) and informs medical strategy through capturing and reporting of medical insights
* Keeps current on disease state, therapeutic landscape, and competitor data and records insights
* Utilize effective, confident, and professional communications to establish strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Respond to and documents unsolicited medical requests (MIRs) for information in a timely manner
* Support Market Access by educating payers (Health plans and state Medicaids) and key decision makers (Pharmacists and P&T Committees) on the clinical efficacy and safety profile to support formulary decisions
* Liaise unsolicited submissions and information for investigator-initiated trials (IITs) between the investigator and home office Medical Affairs
* Lead and/or participate in special projects or initiatives aligned to US Medical strategy and objectives
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities

Professional Experience/Qualifications

* A scientific or clinical professional with a passion for science and deep scientific knowledge
* At least 2 years of experience in a Medical Science Liaison or similar role (MG disease experience preferred); will consider candidates with > 5 years of MG clinical experience
* Must have well-established networks and active relationships with KOLs in the MG community
* Strong knowledge of GCP guidelines and clinical trial processes
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex science into clear, actionable insights
* Energetically embraces responsibilities, demonstrates initiative, and excellent time management
* Agile, adaptable
* A collaborative mindset and genuine passion for improving patient outcomes
* Field-based, with the ability to travel approximately 75%

Education

* Advanced Scientific or Clinical degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP) with a minimum of 2 years of relevant clinical or pharmaceutical experience; NP or PA with 5 or more years clinical experience in MG will be considered. Must reside in the territory.

*Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The company does not sponsor employment visas for this position.*

*TG Therapeutics is an equal employment opportunity employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, ancestry, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition or any other protected characteristic.*

jobs.title: SENIOR INTERNAL AUDITOR
jobs.description:
Job Purpose   

Perform assigned audit engagements, from start to finish, inclusive of preplanning and wrap up activities. Applies risk and control concepts to scenarios encountered and identifies any potential issues.   
Assist in the periodic Risk Assessments and development of the Risk-Based Work Plans and the periodic reporting to the Audit Committee and Senior Management on internal audit activities, performance, significant risk exposures, controls/governance issues and other related matters.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 1)   

**Professional Ethics**  
•    Participate in initiating/promoting the establishment and continuous improvement of the Corporate Governance Framework including Enterprise Risk Management, Corporate Code of Conduct, Ethics and Values.  
**Internal Audit Plan**  
•     Assist in the development of Annual Audit Plan (AAP) based on the results of risk assessment exercise.  
•     Provide input for the periodic reporting on audit activities and performance relative to its plans, significant risk exposures, control/governance issues and other related matters.  
**Audit Execution**  
•    Assist the auditors in the examination and analysis of records through executing audit program steps for the assigned audits.  
•    Develop process understanding of assigned business processes and determines business objectives, main functions, the nature of activities, potential risks and controls to be reviewed.Develop a detailed audit program / Risk & Control Matrix (RCM) for the assigned audit including the objectives, potential risk, key controls, audit procedures and the use of audit techniques and tools to evaluate governance, risks and controls processes, and submits audit program to for review and approval.  
•    Determine auditing procedures to be applied, including the use of Information Systems Audit Techniques, statistical sampling method or others.Ensure that adequate working papers and all relevant information are continuously documented and updated in the automated Audit Management System in accordance with pre-defined templates and audit procedures.  
•    Perform the audit in accordance with the approved audit program and ensures that audit objectives have been met to support the audit conclusions/results.  
•    Identify, obtain, analyse and appraise related systems and evidentiary data/information.  
•    Prepare working papers which record and summarize data on the assigned audit and the results of the audit examination.  
•    Appraise the adequacy of the corrective actions taken by management on audit recommendations through follow up audits and periodically reviews and updates the status of management action plans.   
•    Ensures that approved audit objectives have been met with adequate coverage of all relevant areas. Also ensures that sufficient appropriate audit evidence is obtained to support the conclusion and recommendations, and that the work has been performed in accordance with professional audit standards.  
•    Participate in conducting special reviews and undertakes administrative duties as directed by Head of Internal Audit.  
•    Perform (also supervises audits performed by Internal Auditors) in accordance with the approved RACM and professional standards on internal auditing.  
•    Ensures tasks assigned to junior staff are adequately performed and deliverables are in accordance with ADNOC Internal Audit procedures and quality standards.  
•    Identify high risk areas and key control points of the system to be reviewed.  
•    Evaluate the system’s effectiveness based on his / her business and audit experience and modifies, if necessary, the scope of the review, with the approval of Team Leader / Department Manager.  
•    Participate in special committees to provide independent and objective professional advice and consultancy services.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 2)   

**Audit Reports**  
•    Prepare audit report with conclusion, expressing professional opinions on the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management, control systems and the efficiency with which activities are carried out. Recommends improvement options to rectify reported deficiencies, for Team Leader / Department Manager’s review.  
•    Recommend practical improvements options corresponding to the observations with an objective to contribute to the improvement of governance, risks and control processes to assist in the achievement of the company business objectives.  
•    Follow- up on replies to issued draft and final audit reports and review the adequacy of the corrective actions taken on audit recommendations / improvement options.  
**Coordination**  
•    Assist Audit Management in arranging Audit Committee meetings, preparing the agenda, and minutes of meetings (MOMs) and reporting on Corporate Governance Framework, General Controls and other related issues as prescribed in the Audit Committee Charter.   
•    Conducts workshops or presentations to create awareness about IA function and demonstrate value addition across the ADNOC.  
•    Communicates identified issues with Internal Audit management to ensure potential high risk area of concerns are addressed in a timely and effective manner.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**  
•    Participate in the development and implementation of the automated Audit Management System.  
•    Provide professional advice on Group Companies’ Audit Committee Charter,   
**IA Charter and IA Methodology/Procedures. Provides assistance in the establishment of the Group Audit Committees/IA functions and related governance, when assigned.**  
•    Participate in initiating and coordinating the Group-wide specialized professional training programs.   
•    Conducts research and benchmarking to resolve audit issues, identify gaps and support IA function.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 3)   
  
Generic Accountabilities   

**Supervision**  
•    Plan, supervise and coordinate all activities in the assigned area to meet functional objectives.  
•    Train and develop the assigned staff on relevant skills to enable them to become proficient on the job and deliver the respective section objectives.  
**Budgets**  
•    Provide input for preparation of the Section / Department budgets and assist in the implementation of the approved Budget and work plans to deliver Section objectives.   
•    Investigate and highlight any significant variances to support effective performance and cost control  
**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures**  
•    Implement approved Section / Department policies, processes, systems, standards and procedures in order to support execution of the Section’s / Department work programs in line with Company and International standards.  
**Performance Management**  
•    Contribute to the achievement of the approved Performance Objectives for the Section / Department in line with the Company Performance framework.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**  
•    Design and implement new tools and techniques to improve the quality and efficiency of operational processes.  
•    Identify improvements in internal processes against best practices in pursuit of greater efficiency in line with ISO standards in order to define intelligent solutions for issues confronting the function.  
**Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Sustainability**  
•    Comply with relevant HSE policies, procedures & controls and applicable legislation and sustainability guidelines in line with international standards, best practices and ADNOC Code of Practices.  
**Reports**  
•    Provide inputs to prepare Section MIS and progress reports for Company Management.

  
  
  
Generic Accountabilities (continue)   
  
Internal Communications & Working Relationships   

•    Regular Contacts with operational level management within all auditable departments throughout ADNOC.  
•    Frequent contacts within ADNOC at all levels of Management u

Ensures regulatory compliance across aviation safety and environmental systems by monitoring adherence to local and international aviation regulations, supporting internal audits, validating corrective actions, and contributing to the continuous improvement of safety and environmental performance within the sector.

  

**Key Responsibilities/Duties**

  

1.**Monitor regulatory compliance** with local and international aviation safety and environmental standards, ensuring alignment with ICAO, GCAA, and DCAA requirements.

3.**Review and assess safety management system (SMS) documentation**, including safety reports, risk assessments, and change management submissions to ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks.

6.**Maintain an integrated compliance database** to support decision‑making, reporting, and regulatory oversight activities.

8.**Assist in developing and updating policies, procedures, and work instructions** related to regulatory compliance and quality assurance.

**Certifications:**

  

·ICAO Safety Management (SMS) certification preferred.

  

·ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 auditor certification is an advantage.

  

·Aviation regulatory compliance or auditing certifications are desirable.

·Experience operating within government or statutory regulatory bodies, demonstrating familiarity with public sector governance, accountability, and compliance standards, is an advantage.

jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

  

To perform accounting tasks of Finance Operations: Bank transactions, Bank Reconciliation Statements, Maintaining Petty cash, ePayment support, Etisalat payments and extend support to functions of Accounts Payable, Receivable, General Ledger, Fixed Assets and Budgeting.

  

**Key Responsibilities/Duties**

  

**1.****Record and Maintain DCAA Accounts**

  

Recording, Updating, attaching, and matching of various documents such as Purchase/Sale Invoices, Delivery notes of Goods and Services, Purchase Orders, Customers Report – Direct Issue Voucher etc; and record the transaction in the GRP Accounts Payable/Receivable system. Extract and provide information to Finance Analyst for reporting and cash management to ensure accuracy of all the transactions recorded.

  

**2.****Processing Payments**

  

Review of DCAA Accounts Payable/Receivables. Payables - supplier’s statements, priority payments and proceed with preparation of payment vouchers for payments dues and facilitate the workflow of verification and approval. Receivables - Follow-up for collection due before deadlines, tracking of cash and cheque deposits, bank transfers and matching receipts against the relevant invoices and collection of payments.

Review bank transactions in DCAA bank statement of accounts and DCAA GRP Books and preparation of monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements and ensure matching of records. Prepare collections/payments reports and issues raised to Financial Analyst or Specialist.

  

**4.****Monthly Reporting**

  

Prepare and review monthly reports of revenue Collection & invoice payments, prepare acknowledgement reports, extracting and scrutinizing reports related to closing activities of GRP accounting modules, Transfer of data from Accounts Receivable/Payable to General Ledger and closing periods.

  

**5.****Filing & Documentation**

  

Filing of the copies of payment/receipt vouchers, bank documents, collection reports, bank transfer advice and other collection related documents in proper files and to ensure accessible to management and auditors any time.

Perform any job-related activities of Accounts Payable, General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Budgeting etc; as requested by the Head of Section.

·Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance or related field preferred.

·GRP FINANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets and General Ledger).

·Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in financial management, accounting, budgeting, and financial reporting with a Diploma degree; or fresh graduate with a Bachelor’s degree, or fresh graduate with a Master’s degree.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - FP&A and Corporate Finance | Al-Futtaim Automotive | Dubai
jobs.description:
Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.

  

By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

  

**Overview of the Role**

  

We are currently hiring a **Senior Financial Analyst – FP&A & Corporate Finance** to join a dynamic and fast-paced business environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded finance professional who thrives on transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive business performance. The role will play a key part in business planning, financial forecasting, performance analysis, investment evaluation, and strategic decision-making across multiple business streams.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead the annual budgeting process, quarterly forecasts, and long-term strategic planning.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models to support business decision-making.
* Prepare monthly management reports, financial commentary, and variance analysis.
* Analyze revenue, margins, pricing, costs, and profitability trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Monitor operating expenses and support cost optimization initiatives.
* Deliver insightful performance reporting and business reviews for senior leadership.
* Evaluate capital expenditure projects and business investments using NPV, IRR, payback, and sensitivity analysis.
* Support cash flow forecasting, working capital management, and capital efficiency initiatives.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to challenge assumptions, improve performance, and drive business growth.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of financial planning and reporting processes.

**Required Skills to Be Successful**

  

* Strong expertise in FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.
* Advanced financial modeling, scenario planning, and sensitivity analysis skills.
* Proven capability in variance, profitability, margin, and cost analysis.
* Experience with investment appraisal and business case development.
* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate data into commercial insights.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP, planning, and BI platforms.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**About the Team**

  

You will be joining a high-performing finance team that partners closely with business leaders to drive financial performance and strategic growth. The team plays a critical role in planning, forecasting, performance management, investment analysis, and delivering insights that support key business decisions. The environment encourages collaboration, continuous improvement, commercial thinking, and professional development.

  

**What Equips You for the Role**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* Professional qualification such as CA, CPA, CFA, ACCA, CMA, or MBA in Finance, or active progression towards one.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience within FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, or related finance functions.
* Proven experience in business planning, forecasting, performance analysis, cost management, and cash flow forecasting.
* Experience in asset-intensive, distribution, retail, automotive, or similar sectors is advantageous.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to influence business stakeholders and challenge constructively.
* High attention to detail, integrity, accountability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

We’re here to provide excellent service but a little help from you can ensure a five-star candidate experience from start to finish.

  

Before you click “apply”: Please read the job description carefully to ensure you can confidently demonstrate why this opportunity is right for you and take the time to put together a well-crafted and personalised CV to further boost your visibility. Our global Talent Acquisition team members are all assigned to specific businesses to ensure that we make the best matches between talent and opportunities. We not only consider the requisite compatibility of skills and behaviours, but also how candidates align with our Values of Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence.

  

As part of our candidate experience promise, we also want to make ourselves available to you throughout the application process. We make every effort to review and respond to every application.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.
