jobs.title: Accounting-Accountant ( Outsource)
jobs.description:
****أهداف الوظيفة****

  

إثبات المصروفات والإيرادات و تسجيل الاصول الثابتة في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية و إعداد التسويات البنكية وإصدار التقارير ذات العلاقة.

  

****اهم المسؤوليات****

  

1.استلام فواتير الموردين وتصنيفها عن طريق إدخالها في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية بغرض إثباتها في الحسابات.

  

2.إعداد سندات الصرف واصدار الشيكات او التحويلات البنكية و متابعة الحصول على التوقيعات اللازمة وفقا للصلاحيات المعتمدة لصرف المبالغ الصحيحة.

  

3.إثبات كافة قيود العمليات المحاسبية حسب التوجيه المحاسبي السليم وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة .

  

4.إعداد التسويات البنكية الدورية وإعداد التسويات اللازمة وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة عن طريق إجراء المقارنات بين فواتير المدفوعات والإيرادات و الدفعات البنكية.

  

5.صرف كشوفات الرواتب الشهرية لموظفي الهيئة عن طريق التحويلات البنكية وفقاً للإجراءات المحاسبية المعتمدة ومتابعة الحصول على الإعتمادات اللازمة للصرف.

  

6.إثبات المنافع المالية ( المنفعة الدورية – منفعة تجهيز مسكن – منفعة السكن المؤقت ) في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية بغرض إثباتها في الحسابات.

  

7.صرف المنافع المالية ( المنفعة الدورية – منفعة تجهيز مسكن – منفعة السكن المؤقت ) من خلال بطاقات المستفيدين للمنفعة .

  

8.إثبات الإيرادات الخاصة بالتراخيص وإعداد الايصالات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية وفقاً للبنود الخاصة بها .

  

9.استلام تقارير التشغيلية لقاعات الأفراح (مثال : قاعات الطوار والبرشاء) من مركز دبي التجاري و مراجعتها وإثبات الإيرادات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية

  

10.التأكد من تحويل ايرادات قاعات الافراح من خلال موقع البنك و إعداد الإيصالات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية.

  

11.التحقق من استلام الشيكات و التحويلات البنكية للمبالغ الواردة من اموال الزكاة و التبرعات و اثباتها في انظمة الموارد الحكومية.

  

12.استلام أوامر صرف أموال الزكاه والمساهمات المجتمعية والتبرعات ولجنة صندوق التضامن و لجنه الحالات الانسانية و ادخالها في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية واثباتها في حسابات الهيئة بهدف توزيعها على الحسابات ذات العلاقة ليتم صرفها للمستحقين وفقاً للاجراءات المعتمدة.

  

13.متابعة ملاحظات الإغلاق الشهري لحسابات الهيئة عن طريق إصدار التقارير المالية من خلال أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية.

  

14.تسجيل الأصول الثابتة في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية لأثباتها في دفاتر حسابات الهيئة.

  

15.المشاركة في فريق الجرد السنوي لإجراء عمليات الجرد السنوية ومطابقتها مع أرصدة الحسابات الموجودة في الأستاذ العام.

  

16.التنسيق مع موظفي المشتريات فيما يتعلق بدفعات الموردين وإعداد مطابقات حسابات الموردين وإعتمادها.

  

17.إعداد التقارير الدورية عن الإيرادات والمصروفات عن طريق أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية وفقاً لمتطلبات الأقسام .

  

18.مراجعة ومطابقة الفواتير مع طلبات الشراء المعتمدة ورفع التوصيات بالمتطلبات مثل ( عقود الشركات ، رسائل تجديد العقود ، العروض المالية للشركات وما إلى ذلك )

  

19.استلام الإيرادات النقدية وإيداعها في حساب البنكي الخاص بإيرادات حكومة دبي.

  

20.الإلتزام بسياسات وإجراءات أمن المعلومات المعتمدة بالهيئة والعمل على الامتثال بالضوابط لضمان سرية المعلومات

  

21.أية مهام أو اختصاصات في نطاق مسؤوليات الوظيفة.

  

****المتطلبات التعليمية****

  

·بكالوريس في المحاسبة أو ما يعادلها.

  

·اجادة اللغتين الانكليزية والعربية(محادثة وكتابة)

  

****متطلبات الخبرة****

  

من 0 – 2 سنوات خبرة في الحسابات.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant - Accounting and Controls
jobs.description:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.

  
  
  

**About Eaton**

  
  

Eaton is a power management company where we provide energy-efficient solutions that help our customers effectively manage electrical, hydraulic and mechanical power more efficiently, safely and sustainably. Eaton is dedicated to improving the quality of life and the environment through the use of power management technology and services. Eaton has approximately 96,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries.

  
  
  

The **Senior Accountant - Accounting and Controls** will provide leadership of the Accounting function for allocated sites/ledgers. Ensuring accuracy of US GAAP and local GAAP numbers, and that all compliance requirements are met. This role will have a strong focus on the standardization and optimization of financial processes across allocated sites, rolling out strategic initiatives and working closely with the Controllership (incl. Global Financial Accounting) and COEs (Pune & Budapest).

  
  
What you’ll do:  
  

• Responsibility for closing, accounting, and reporting for allocated sites, ensuring each close is completed accurately and in line with operational reporting timetables  
• Ensure control environment. Adherence to all Eaton Policies, US GAAP, SOX and local statutory/tax compliance requirements must be maintained  
• Prepare and run analysis on ARCS Balance Sheet Reconciliations.   
• Partner with Operations to help execute business strategies, develop a detailed understanding of the operational activities and build business acumen  
• Support all strategic projects within the region such as tax, restructuring, M&A activities, payroll, system implementations and other ad-hoc projects  
• Drive optimization through standardization, simplification and automation of financial processes within the zone, working closely with Controllership, the COEs and Operations to build out and achieve the most efficient and effective organization  
• Support business & accounting and controls processes improvements and transitions  
• Support all statutory, tax, customs and internal audits  
• Ethical standards must be maintained at all times 

  
  
Qualifications:  
  

* Degree in Accounting / Finance, Master's Degree (professional qualification) is preferred
* 5+ years of relevant work experience in Accounting, Finance

  
Skills:  
  

* Experience of finance/accounting within a multinational manufacturing environment
* Exposure to Sarbanes Oxley and US GAAP desirable
* Fluent in business English; one or more local country language fluency desirable
* Ability to operate and deliver independently
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong technical skills with a high business acumen
* Change management and continuous improvement mindset
* Able to work as part of a team and adhere to company standard processes, practices & policies
* Strongly invested in life-long learning
* Comfortable dealing with ambiguity
* Skilled at building organisational capability

  

**Living and Working in Dubai**

  
  

Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.

  
  

At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.

jobs.title: UAE Branch Accountant | Al-Futtaim Automotive | FAMCO
jobs.description:
**About Al-Futtaim**

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview Of The Role:**

  

* The Branch Accountant supports day-to-day dealership finance operations, ensuring accurate accounting and compliance with financial policies.
* The role involves close collaboration with finance and branch teams to ensure transactions are reviewed, documented, and reconciled. Major responsibilities include supporting vehicle deal documentation, pricing, discount checks, and overseeing cash and banking activities.
* This position requires a focus on the accuracy and timeliness of financial transactions and adherence to month-end timelines.
* The role demands proactive management of daily finance operations within a high-volume automotive environment.

**What You Will Do:**

  

* Review and support the posting of daily branch transactions, including invoices, receipts, customer collections, and vendor payments.
* Support vehicle deals by checking financial aspects, pricing, and discount requests, ensuring accuracy and proper approvals.
* Monitor cash collections, bank deposits, and petty cash, ensuring balances are accurate and reconciled.
* Prepare and follow up on reconciliations for customer accounts, vendor balances, and petty cash.
* Assist with month-end close activities, including accrual inputs, provisions, and journal support.
* Track branch operating expenses, purchase orders, and supplier invoices to identify issues like overspending or miscoding.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies, delegation of authority (DOA), internal controls, and audit requirements.

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

  

* Proficiency in reconciliation and numerical accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Good Excel skills and the ability to manage trackers.
* Ability to manage daily priorities and meet month-end deadlines.

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

  

* Degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related field.
* Basic understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial controls.
* 2-4 years of experience in accounting, branch finance, or high-volume transactional finance.
* Experience with ERP systems, particularly SAP, and dealership finance operations.

**About Al-Futtaim** **Automotive**

  

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

  

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

  

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

  

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

  

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - Aldar Education
jobs.description:
Aldar Education is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst. This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled professional to join the highly successful Aldar family of schools and to help shape the future of Abu Dhabi’s leading school group.

  

Since its inception in 2007 with just 250 students, Aldar Education has grown into a highly sought-after education provider, with more than 25 owned and managed premium and super-premium schools and academies- in partnership with some of the world’s most prestigious institutions including Rugby School, King’s College Wimbledon, and Cranleigh. The Group now serves over 38,000 students through 5,000 educators from more than 100 nationalities to deliver world-class education across a broad range of curricula and learning pathways from nursery through to K12.

  

At Aldar Education, our impact goes far beyond the classroom: we are proud to contribute to the UAE’s vision for a sustainable, knowledge-based economy through premium education. With this in mind, we hire educators and industry professionals who not only embody our values and cultural ethos but also bring a genuine passion for education—qualities central to our mission of shaping the leaders of tomorrow.

  

If you are passionate about excellence and ready to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to apply and be part of our journey.

  

This is an exciting opportunity to join the highly successful Aldar family of schools and to help shape the future of Abu Dhabi’s leading school group.

  
  
Responsibilities:  

**Man Duties:**

  

* **Business Planning:** Contribute to the preparation of monthly, quarterly, annual, and long-term (5–10 years) business plans, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* **Budgeting:** Assist in the end-to-end annual budgeting process, including building Excel-based budget models and preparing management presentation decks.
* **Forecasting:** Support monthly forecasting activities across different entities, and maintain up-to-date cash flow forecasts to ensure liquidity planning and monitoring.
* **Financial Modeling:** Develop and maintain robust financial models to project financial statements over 5–10 years, supporting decision-making and scenario analysis.
* **Capital Planning:** Collaborate with stakeholders on the 5-year Capex planning cycle, focusing on investment evaluation, capital allocation, and profit optimization.
* **Financial Analysis & Reporting:** Provide insightful financial reports and analytical tools to monitor business unit performance, establish benchmarks, and measure goal achievement.
* **Data Management:** Coordinate with departments to collect, validate, and manage data sets, ensuring timely and accurate analysis and reporting.
* **Systems & Tools:** Utilize ERP systems and business intelligence tools to extract, analyze, and present financial and operational data for management reporting.
* **Budget Administration:** Manage the upload, validation, and transfer of budgets across cost centers and business units, ensuring compliance with internal financial policies.
* **Automation:** Identify and implement automation opportunities across FP&A processes using AI, VBA macros, and advanced Excel formulas to streamline reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and financial analysis.

  
Qualifications:  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in business or finance
* Master’s in finance / MBA in finance
* Qualified accountant (CA/ CPA/ ACCA/ CMA)

**Minimum Experience:**

  

* Minimum 3 to 7 years of relevant FP&A work experience

**Job Specific Knowledge & Skills:**

  

* Arabic Speaking Preferred.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage tasks diligently and complete them within deadlines.
* Effective multi-tasking and the ability to perform under pressure.
* Well-organized and capable of managing multiple tasks independently.
* Strong interpersonal skills, particularly in a diverse, multicultural environment.
* Willingness to extend effort beyond typical work hours when necessary.
* Proficiency in operating office equipment (PC, photocopier, etc.).
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and Outlook 365.

**What We Offer:**

  

Aldar Education is a family of world-class, child-centered, and innovative schools based in the UAE. We educate students across our group of owned and managed schools and as we grow, so does our need for highly skilled, inspirational, and dedicated school and educational leaders. We offer an attractive remuneration package including a range of benefits. Our future-focused learning model includes both students and staff, so we place a special emphasis on professional development, coaching, and training.

  

Successful candidates will have access to a wide network of professionals and opportunities to both lead and contribute to training others as well as developing themselves.

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Full Time Analyst, Dubai, UAE 2027
jobs.description:
Job Overview  
  

**You're the brains behind our work**

  
  

You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it's honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can't come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when.

  
  

Citi is looking for full-time Analysts to join the Corporate Banking team in Dubai. Corporate Bankers are relationship-focused finance professionals responsible for understanding the wide range of complex financial issues facing our clients around the world. As a Corporate Banker, you will drive the client dialogue on capital structure, liability management, liquidity and funding strategies, risk management and investment solutions.

  
  

Unique to Citi, Corporate Bankers are also responsible for deciding where to invest the firm's capital and executing on those investments. Corporate Bankers work in partnership with various Citi groups across the firm including Risk Management, Investment Banking and the Capital Markets Origination. If none of these terms make sense right now, that's ok! As a Corporate Banking Analyst, you will join a training program in Dubai, where you will receive an in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi's culture. So whatever your degree is in we will give you the training you need to excel.

  
  

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed**

  
  

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Analyst Program starts in mid-July 2025 and begins with a six to eight week in-depth training program. You will then be placed with a Corporate Banking team to work with for the duration of the Program. By the third year of the program; Analysts will have the opportunity to take advantage of internal mobility opportunities.

  
  

**Your time here will look something like this…**

  

* Conduct accounting and financial statement analysis, cash flow modelling and capital markets analysis.
* Complete fundamental risk and credit analysis.
* Liaise with product partners.
* Assist in the presentation and development of new ideas to clients.
* Structure deals.

  

**We want to hear from you if...**

  

* You are in your final year of university or graduated.
* Strong academics.
* Interest in business.
* You are fluent in English (another European language desirable).

  

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

  
  

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.

  
  

**We'll also be looking for the following:**

  

* Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn and success in team environments.
* Knowledge of the global or domestic business landscape is a plus, but not required
* Strong communication, planning and organizational skills.
* Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry.
* Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making.

  

We will recruit on a rolling basis and therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Successful candidates will be offered a competitive salary.

jobs.title: Scientific Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.
  
  
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**
**Role Summary**
**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**
The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.
  
  
This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.
  
  
The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.
  
  
**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**
This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.
  
  
Role duties and accountabilities
  
  

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

**Experience, Skills, Knowledge**
Experience Required
  
  

* 5-10 years of experience in relevant scientific field
* Proven expertise engaging with and mobilising scientific KOLs / PHAs and interest groups
* Knowledge and experience of BAT's New Category products, ingredients, and technologies
* Familiarity with BAT’s 9-step scientific risk assessment framework and Tobacco Harm Reduction principles
* Sound knowledge of tobacco, food, or pharmaceutical science complexities including chemistry, toxicology, pre-clinical, clinical, and behavioural science
* Understanding of the regulatory environment in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, especially concerning tobacco, food, medicinal, and pharmaceutical sectors
* Proven experience interacting with regulatory authorities in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, managing pharmaceutical regulations, regulatory pathways, and scientific requirements, with the capacity to apply this knowledge to complex scientific and policy discussions
* Experience in managing complex market-facing and regulatory dependent projects
* Understands World Health Organization’s political environment and public policy-making processes
* Experience of crafting and managing 3rd party networks
* Experience in regulatory rulemaking processes
* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Outstanding communication abilities

**Technical / Functional / Leadership Skills Required**

* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Strong communication capabilities

**Education / Professional Qualifications / Certifications Required**

* Educated to a post-graduate degree (PhD or equivalent experience, MD, or Pharmacist)
* Excellent written and spoken English

Beneficial
  
  

* Appreciation of challenges of working in a complex matrix environment and proven experience of delivering results
* Active interest in controversial regulatory control issues and skills for absorbing and applying knowledge to the debate

**What we offer you?**

* We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
* Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
* Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter

jobs.title: Senior Quality Specialist – Microbiology Laboratories
jobs.description:
Senior Quality Specialist – Microbiological Analysis Laboratories

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Specialist to join the Microbiological Analysis Laboratories Department and lead quality assurance and accreditation activities in line with international standards.

Location: Dubai

Sector: Government

Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain the laboratory Quality Management System in line with ISO/IEC 17025.

Lead accreditation and re-accreditation activities with EIAC and other accreditation bodies.

Plan and conduct internal audits, and manage nonconformities, root cause analysis, and CAPA.

Oversee method validation and verification, measurement uncertainty, and internal quality control for microbiological tests.

Coordinate proficiency testing and inter-laboratory comparison programs and evaluate results.

Control quality documents, SOPs, and records, and ensure traceability of equipment calibration and reference materials.

Monitor biosafety, environmental monitoring, and media/culture quality control requirements.

Train and support laboratory staff on quality requirements and best practices.

Prepare quality performance reports and KPIs for management review.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Microbiology, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field (Master's preferred).

Minimum [8–10] years of laboratory experience, including at least [5] years in quality assurance within a microbiology laboratory.

Strong, hands-on knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025 and accreditation processes (EIAC experience is an advantage).

Certified Internal Auditor / Lead Assessor for ISO/IEC 17025 (preferred).

Experience with food, water, environmental, or clinical microbiological testing.

Familiarity with LIMS and statistical tools for QC data analysis.

Excellent communication and report-writing skills in Arabic and English.

jobs.title: Senior Research Technician

jobs.description:
**Join us at Miral Experiences!**

Miral Experiences is a region’s leader in the management and operation of world-class, award-winning immersive attractions and experiences across Abu Dhabi. Our diverse portfolio includes some of the most iconic entertainment and leisure destinations, including Ferrari World Yas Island Abu Dhabi, Yas Waterworld Yas Island Abu Dhabi, Warner Bros. World™ Yas Island Abu Dhabi, SeaWorld Yas Island Abu Dhabi, CLYMB™ Yas Island Abu Dhabi, and TeamLab. Phenomena Abu Dhabi, and CLYMB™ Abu Dhabi, as well as cultural treasures like Qasr Al Watan.

We specialize in crafting unique experiences that cater to all tastes and ages, delivering a seamless blend of thrills, joy, and discovery. Our attractions are designed to ignite the imagination and create unforgettable memories for visitors from around the world. Whether you're seeking excitement, relaxation, or cultural enrichment, we offer something for everyone.

**About the Role**

The Senior Research Technician – Marine Ecology is responsible for managing the routine and non-routine technical operations to the Marine Ecology laboratory under the direct leadership of the senior researchers – marine ecology. He/she is responsible for the execution of daily operations and maintenance of the YSWRRC Experimental wet lab facility.

The Research Technician’s main responsibilities are:

* Managing protocols and care for animal and plant research subjects
* Assisting the research team in the implementation of research projects
* Developing and managing complementary research projects
* Performing routine maintenance on facility, systems and equipment
* Providing work direction and training for technicians and student researchers
* Collecting, interpreting, describing and documenting data to support research activities
* Managing scientific databases

**Key Responsibilities**

**Management of cultures and care of research subjects and systems**

* Manages the routine operations of the marine ecology experimental facility, including systems maintenance, water exchange, cleaning tasks and technician schedule
* Manages the husbandry operations of animals/plants present in the laboratory (depending on project including reef fishes, corals, other invertebrates, and seagrass), including feeding and health monitoring
* Leads the breeding and larval rearing of tropical marine fishes and invertebrates for the marine ecology laboratory
* Develops and makes suggestions for improvements to the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and practices which promote high-quality operation of the facility
* Manages all records as required in the SOPs
* Liaises with appropriate teams to maintain health of the cultures, animals as well as the functioning of the systems to the level expected for the research projects

**Support of the research program**

* Assists the ecology team with the design, development, and maintenance of experimental set-ups as required by the research project methodologies and/or directed by the senior researcher
* Sets up and performs research experiments and procedures following prescribed protocol with autonomy (this may include weekend or night-time work
* Develops and manages complementary research projects
* Support with sample processing and data analysis
* Operates field, office, laboratory, and/or shop equipment used in support of research projects
* Collects, interprets, describes, and documents complex analytical and evaluative research data
* Manages data and databases
* Prepares reports, analyses, and basic models identifying progress and trends; makes recommendations or conclusions
* Provides technical aspects for a variety of research project components
* Provides technical training to visiting scientists and university students
* Assists research team with field work

**Management of the marine ecology laboratory and systems maintenance**

* Organizes and maintains and maintains aquarium systems, tools, equipment and grounds
* Monitors supply and equipment inventory to sustain day-to-day operations
* Assists with the maintenance of dry lab facilities (e.g., microscopes, spectrophotometer, Flowcam, nutrient analyzer).

**Support the Center’s activities**

* Supports the rescue operations when required
* Leads the research field operations when required
* Actively contributes to the outreach goals of the YSWRR
* Collaborates with SeaWorld Abu Dhabi Zoological and Education teams as required
* Contributes to the overall success of the YSWRR projects by performing all other duties as assigned

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., animal science, biology, microbiology, aquaculture)
* 4 years of experience as technician in a marine research or aquaculture facility or aquarium
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Experience in marine ecological research in an aquarium and/or experimental setting
* Demonstrated competency in aquaculture operations including breeding, hatchery and larval rearing methodologies
* Good computer skills, including solid competencies using Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word
* Ability to represent the Yas SeaWorld Research and Rescue Center to community, media, government agencies, and conservation associations
* Excellent interpersonal skills and teamwork abilities
* Demonstrated commitment to company values and safety

**Desirable**

* Degree in Marine Ecology or Marine Biology
* 2 years of experience in a marine ecology research institute
* 2 years of experience with coral and/or seagrass husbandry.
* Arabic verbal and written communication skills
* Previous experience in the GCC region
* Evidence of ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary research teams
* Evidence of multicultural skills in the workplace is an advantage

**Shape the Future with Us**

At Miral Experiences, we don’t just create world-class destinations - we create unforgettable memories for our guests and remarkable careers for our people.

From theme parks and attractions to guest services and behind-the-scenes roles, every member of our team plays a part in delivering exceptional experiences. We’re driven by passion, powered by innovation, and committed to excellence in everything we do.

We’re looking for passionate, driven, and talented individuals who are ready to grow, lead, and make a difference. No matter your background or expertise, there's a place for you at Miral Experiences.

* Bachelors of pharmaceutical Science /Medicine / Nutrition / Biology.
